test: creating a task shows it in the list and updates the counter
rationale: The diff shows app/page.tsx changed the input's aria-label from "New task" to "Task title", while the test still uses getByLabel("New task"). The failure is a locator.fill timeout on that stale selector, and it reproduces on both attempts (not flaky). The app's behavior is intact — only the accessible name changed — so this is selector drift in the test, not a product regression.
recommendedAction: Update e2e/tasks.spec.ts to use getByLabel("Task title") (or a stable test id) and re-run the test; optionally add a test-id to the input to avoid future label drift.
